headline: Targa Resources Corp's Dividend Analysis
summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus.  Targa Resources Corp (NYSE:TRGP) recently announced a total dividend of $1.25 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-07-31.  This payment includes a $1.25 per share cash dividend, payable on 2026-08-14.
